title: 1.92TB 3D TLC PCIe 4.0 x4 NVMe U.3 SSD for Dell EMC PowerEdge Servers | Enterprise Drive in 14G Tray
description:
Water Panther 1.92TB PCI-Express Gen4 x4 U.3 2.5-inch SSD with hot-plug 14G Dell caddy tray
Compatible in R440, R640, R740XD, R940 servers and more, additional information in description
Specific riser options are required for certain configurations
Ready to go for read-intensive applications and able to withstand 24x7 operation
Backed by a 2 year warranty, items ship in secure packaging for critical deployment capability
There are a number of riser combinations offered for 14th Generation PowerEdge Servers. Specific riser options are required for certain options like GPU enablement and NVMe PCIe SSD enablement.
